header.description: What: on basic-desert a BLUE stochastic platoon (30 men) and a RED stochastic squad (4 men - the weaker side) face each other 300 m apart on flat ground, both defending; they fire on each other (agg-backend's phase A). Judge: (1) the fire reaches BOTH sides (a Blue man is hit; most of the Red squad is down); (2) suppression rises on both (AggregateUnit.SuppressedShare > 0); (3) the weaker side breaks first - a Red slot's stress reaches the break level before any Blue slot's does. NOT judged: 'losses inside the C-8 band' - no C-8 band applies to this fight (R-8381): agg-backend's ladder (CE-8009, rung 1 PASS) measures 9 v 9 riflemen at 100 / 200 / 275 m, and this duel is a 3-to-1 fight at 300 m, the rifle's exact reach that R-8009 keeps out of the rung; no band is invented. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh agg-platoon-duel
